properties.name: udiv32_magic_differential
properties.formal: ∀ d ∈ u32 divisors (edge-skewed), ∀ x ∈ u32 edges, ∀ shape ∈ {U32Native, U32InI64}: interp(div_by_const_function(f[x /u d])) = x /u d

properties.name: fold_matches_c11_model
properties.formal: ∀ E ∈ all-const DAGs over I8..U64 (well-typed Value uses, sign-matched cmps, no div-by-zero): fold∘copy_prop to fixpoint leaves Return = Const(interp(E))
properties.counterexample: I8 DAG LShr(Const(I8(-72)), Const(I8(1)), I8): fold gives -36, C11 requires 92

properties.name: narrow_preservation
properties.formal: ∀ pat ∈ documented narrowing patterns: interp(narrow_function(f[pat]), args) = interp(f[pat], args); unsigned cmps on signed source asserted NOT rewritten
properties.counterexample: f(a:i32,b:i32)->i64 { Or(sext a, sext b) at I64 } narrowed to Or@I32 with no re-extension; f(1,-1)=4294967295 != -1 (pipeline-confirmed)

properties.name: pipeline_value_preservation
properties.formal: ∀ shape ∈ {linear, diamond, loop, random CFG, div32}, ∀ args: interp(run_passes(shape), args) = interp(shape, args); no panic

bugs.summary: constant_fold sign-extends sub-int operands before logical ops (LShr/UDiv/URem at I8/I16 fold wrong)
bugs.impact: latent silent miscompile: I8/I16-typed logical shifts / unsigned div-rem of negative constants fold to wrong constants
bugs.expected: LShr((I8)0xB8, 1) folds to 92 (logical shift of the 8-bit pattern)
bugs.actual: folds to -36 — the is_32bit fast path's `as u32` sign-extends 0xB8 to 0xFFFFFFB8 before the logical op
bugs.counterexample: I8 DAG LShr(Const(I8(-72)), Const(I8(1)), I8): fold gives -36, C11 requires 92
bugs.fix: In fold_binop's is_32bit logical arms, zero-extend the sub-int operand pattern (mask to the operand type's width before widening)

bugs.summary: narrow Phase 2 rewrites I64 bitwise ops to I32 without checking the use — I64 consumers get the zero-extended value (pipeline miscompile)
bugs.impact: run_passes(-O2, x86-64) compiles f(a,b){(i64)a | (i64)b} to return the zero-extended 32-bit Or: f(1,-1) = 4294967295 instead of -1
bugs.expected: pipeline preserves the interpreted value: sext(a)|sext(b) = -1 for (1,-1)
bugs.actual: Or rewritten to I32 with no re-extension; the I64 return reads 4294967295
bugs.counterexample: f(a:i32,b:i32)->i64 { Or(sext a, sext b) at I64 } narrowed to Or@I32 with no re-extension; f(1,-1)=4294967295 != -1 (pipeline-confirmed)
bugs.fix: Check the single use consumes the value in an I32/U32 context before rewriting (or emit Cast target_ty→I64 after the narrowed op)
bugs.documentedBehavior: "narrows I64 bitwise operations (And, Or, Xor) to I32 when all operands are provably 32-bit values ... restricted to I32/U32 output to avoid sub-int register complications" — src/passes/README.md Integer Narrowing, Phase 2
